notes: The live listing count observed in this run was 273, three below the user's approximate control of 276.
The broad Flatbed & Tarpaulin category path mixes real curtainsiders with swap bodies/BDF, reefers, box trailers, platforms and other body types; category membership alone is insufficient.
One listing detail page was opened to capture price from its actual price block. Remaining segment records are listing-page-only; missing fields remain null pending detail-page enrichment.
URLs for the candidate records use TruckScout24's verified ID-to-URL format; each record retains its listing ID for deduplication.

Continued through TruckScout24 search content and listing detail pages after the initial checkpoint: enriched listing 22898710 and added two directly verified curtain-side listings. Listing 17619548 came from a related-listings panel and is kept separate from the initial search-page count until cross-checked.

On 2026-11-02, detail pages confirmed exact ID, canonical URL, price block, registration/year, axles and axle maker where explicit, and explicit VINs for IDs 17620558 and 17619548. Seller names were not exposed in the public detail view.

Further verified detail-page enrichment: IDs 23269042 (€5,200 net), 23224101 (€7,200 net), and 21724618 (€5,500 net). A search-index card had shown €5,100 for 21724618, but the current detail-page price block shows €5,500, which is the recorded current observation.

Page 7 produced another confirmed COIL curtainsider: ID 22051613, Kögel S24-1, €9,750 net / €11,798 gross, first registration 01/2020, 3 axles. A separate Mega Light Plus listing (ID 22751987) says fast sliders and sliding roof but not side curtains; it remains in review and is excluded from confirmed segment.

Page 8 detail inspection: confirmed listing A225-63-072 (ID 22563072), Kögel SN 24 COIL curtainsider, €9,250 net / €11,192 gross, first registration 06/2019, 3 axles, SAF stated in title. Excluded A222-98-977 (ID 22298977): although described as curtainsider, listing states interchangeable platform trailer and is categorized under containers/swap bodies, so it is not counted as a whole semi-trailer.

Additional category spot-check: the site category Kögel Semitrailers With Flatbed & Tarpaulin showed 270 listings in the crawl, but included clear BDF/Wechselpritsche swap bodies (IDs 23195871 and 18505251), confirming category count cannot be treated as whole curtainsider semitrailer count. Added confirmed whole semi-trailer ID 22974347: Kögel SN24 Standard Edscha, €8,850 net / €10,532 gross, first registration 03/2017, 3 axles, SAF, lift axle. XXL certificate is recorded as stated; Code XL remains unconfirmed.

Project target-year rule applied separately from body classification: real tarp semitrailers A231-97-966 (ID 23197966, first registration 02/2023) and A215-05-557 (ID 21505557, first registration 03/2024) are preserved in out_of_scope_records, not in the 2008-2022 target segment.

Category page 2 spot-check added/enriched IDs 23271247 (€7,900 net / €9,401 gross, 02/2019, 3 axles SAF) and 22600387 (€10,300 net / €12,463 gross, 04/2019, 3 axles SAF, lift axle). Both are explicit curtainsider/open tarp semitrailers; price histories append the live detail-page observations.
